seoTitle: Free Personality Quiz Template: Which Type Are You?
seoDescription: Personality quiz template with eight fun questions, each answer tied to one of four types: Adventurer, Planner, Free Spirit or Connector. Share it in minutes.

content.intro: A personality quiz is a form that asks light, scenario-based questions where each answer points to a personality type, so people can find out which type they are and share the result. This template has eight questions with four answers each, labeled A to D, and each letter maps to one type: Adventurer, Planner, Free Spirit or Connector.
content.audience: Marketers, community managers, teachers, event hosts and creators who want a shareable quiz for engagement or icebreakers.
useCases: A shareable quiz on social media or in a newsletter to grow engagement
An icebreaker for team offsites, workshops or classes
A lead magnet on a website that asks for an email to send the result
A themed quiz for an event, retreat or product launch
tips: Results work by majority: the thank-you message lists what 'mostly A, B, C or D' means, so people see their type as soon as they submit.
Add the email plugin with 'recipient from field' to send each person an email copy that includes the type descriptions.
Rename the four types and rewrite the options to match your brand, topic or event; keep each letter tied to the same type in every question.

faq.question: What should a personality quiz include?
faq.answer: Four to six clearly different personality types, six to ten everyday scenario questions, one answer per type in every question, a short description of each type, and a way to show the result, such as a thank-you message or a follow-up email.

faq.question: How are personality quiz results calculated here?
faq.answer: Each answer is labeled A, B, C or D, and each letter belongs to one type. The respondent counts which letter they picked most, and the thank-you message tells them which type that is. Quiz grading is not used, because there are no right or wrong answers.

faq.question: Is this a scientific personality test?
faq.answer: No. It is a fun, light quiz for engagement and conversation, not a validated psychological assessment like the Big Five. Do not use it for hiring or clinical decisions.

faq.question: Can I collect emails with a personality quiz?
faq.answer: Yes. The email field is optional here; make it required if the quiz is a lead magnet, and say clearly what you will send so people know why you are asking.

fields.label: It's a free Saturday. What are you doing?
options: A. Trying something I've never done, like rock climbing
B. Ticking off my to-do list, then a well-earned rest
C. Wandering wherever the day takes me
D. Brunch with friends that turns into an all-day hangout

fields.label: Pick a holiday
options: A. Backpacking somewhere off the map
B. A city break with every day mapped out
C. A cabin with art supplies and no schedule
D. A big group trip with friends or family

fields.label: Your phone's home screen is
options: A. A mess of travel and outdoor apps
B. Neatly sorted into folders
C. A photo I took, no widgets
D. Full of group chats with unread messages

fields.label: A friend asks for advice. You
options: A. Tell them to go for it, what's the worst that can happen?
B. Make a pros and cons list together
C. Ask how it feels and tell them to trust their gut
D. Introduce them to someone who has been through it

fields.label: At a party you're usually
options: A. The one suggesting the next adventure
B. The one who organized it
C. Off in a corner having a deep chat
D. Introducing everyone to everyone

fields.label: Pick a superpower
options: A. Teleportation
B. Seeing the future
C. Shape-shifting
D. Reading minds

fields.label: Your ideal job would involve
options: A. Travel and new challenges every week
B. Clear goals and room to build something that lasts
C. Creative freedom and flexible hours
D. Working with people and building a community

fields.label: Which word sounds most like you?
options: A. Bold
B. Reliable
C. Imaginative
D. Warm

layout.content:
Which type are you?

Eight quick questions, no wrong answers. About two minutes.
layout.thankYouContent:
Count your letters

Mostly A: The Adventurer, bold and curious. Mostly B: The Planner, calm and organized. Mostly C: The Free Spirit, creative and spontaneous. Mostly D: The Connector, warm and social.
